title: Circuit breaker: wrap KuboHttpClient block_put and block_get
description: Wrap KuboHttpClient in CircuitBreaker. When Open: block_put and block_get return Err immediately without HTTP call. NNTP layer maps this to 403/503 with 'block store unavailable' message. When Half-Open: one probe request per interval. Blocked on: stoa-3e2e43e6.
